scope: One matched full-route current eight -1 rad capacity comparison, not a motor selection or global/default adoption test.
cap_interface: Both physical plant and state mirror operating bounds change after fixed original .30 design/gain construction. Preparation uses operating bounds; this is not a final-clip-only ablation.

geometric_path.distance: Exact Euclidean point-to-segment minimum on full fixed uniform-u polyline, not exact analytic curve distance.
geometric_path.crossing_limitation: Near-path distance at the crossing can hide wrong progress; timed XY remains independent.

command_metrics.terminal: Final emitted unheld command excluded from interval/duration/step/clipping metrics; its finite status reported separately.
command_metrics.actual_limits: Report requested clipping at own arm caps and applied input compliance with those caps.
command_metrics.common_limits: Also report requested excess and actual applied exceedance versus original .30 belt caps using fixed original bounds for normalization.
command_metrics.durations: Use actual held interval durations as well as fractions; larger cap denominators alone are not improvement.
command_metrics.steps: Report both own-cap normalized and original-bound normalized Euclidean command steps, plus dimensional per-channel peaks.

screen.hard: Both complete133s finite and without declared physical failure; applied bounds, clip identity, prior-input history, original observer/contact-information boundary, original heading helper off, same initial state/reference/design/gain bytes. Fresh B030 matches all79 original I76 precision fields.
screen.settling: Preserve any original B030 four-condition final2s settling success. Absolute candidate settling remains explicit even if B030 fails.
screen.decision: INVALID_SETUP if source/schema/pair/reference/gain/native-parity/ledger fails. FAIL_CAPACITY_SCREEN if any hard or fixed benefit/nonregression/conditional-settling gate fails; otherwise PASS_CAPACITY_SCREEN for this pair only. No automatic adoption.
screen.clipping_note: Own-cap clipping improvement alone cannot pass. Belt clipping/excess at own and original scales remain descriptive; unchanged motor-torque clipping seconds and original-scale command-step/motion guards are compared.

fixed_analysis_policy: All full-route and fixed-focus results retained. No phase/window/threshold/cap/gain retuning or outcome-based retries.
interpretation_limits: This is ideal prescribed belt surface speed, without belt motor torque/load dynamics.
A better motion result does not select or validate a real motor.
One phase/route cannot establish general controller improvement.
The fixed focus window is descriptive and cannot replace whole-route evaluation.
Without new1ms force instrumentation do not claim the I81 positive-force pulses are removed; evaluate visible motion and sampled existing signals only.
